verdict: Current-data implementation and prepared paired-screen package have no remaining reviewed blocker. CPU evidence establishes data delivery and lifecycle contracts only; it does not establish model adoption, causal score benefit, or permission for a GPU launch.

source_review.host_binding: Session UUID, reset attempt, action_num, level, settled frame hash and revision; optional at token compared canonically including JSON types.
source_review.action_boundary: Original action called once; short bookkeeping locks do not span it. Post-action finally and every query verify current identity. Actual no-op/RESET invalidates; refused action does not. Inflight query returns no payload.
source_review.commit: Host stores a validated immutable JSON encoding atomically before synchronous IPC acknowledgment. Acknowledged commit survives snippet error/timeout. Missing acknowledgment is unknown outcome.
source_review.scope_and_copy: Host-owned bounded per-session stores; stale/evicted responses contain no saved value; get decodes an independent JSON copy. Old evicted session identity does not resurrect.
source_review.sandbox_integration: Existing animation IPC multiplexed with whitelist fields and forced current_data query. Bound session callback captured at sandbox entry. API injected before retained-function available_names. Original latest-animation enablement preserved.
source_review.baseline_boundary: Only current_data arm imports/installs. 003/006/007 disabled;010 archive not enabled. Original ordinary-variable and function-retention policy preserved.
resolved_during_review: Action bookkeeping/clock failures originally could mask original action outcome; fail-open wrapper and sentinel-identity fault checks now cover this.
IPC request fields originally could override query routing; forwarded fields are now whitelisted and query is forced.

saved_frame_cases.scope: Handwritten CPU data-channel probes on saved public frames; no model adoption or game improvement claim.
saved_frame_cases.interpretation: Handwritten compute→put→host ack→later get→direct consumer succeeds; baseline pure-function recomputation also reproduces values. This proves an additional data handoff route, not additional observation information or model adoption.

remaining_limits: No production concurrency pressure or real fatal auto-reset sequence demonstrated.
Host current-data values are not verified facts; at omitted binds write time only.
Previously returned local Python aliases do not auto-invalidate.
Canonical JSON byte counters are not RSS or model-visible stdout characters.
Candidate prompt adds API instructions; selection/query behavior and shared scheduling can still affect per-game compute allocation.
No score, medal or prize improvement is established by these CPU checks.
